name: misaligned
description: Outcomes that do not move their goal, an outcome whose statement and behavior change disagree, and duplicate intent.
expectations: Flags that outcome-2 ('Engineers deploy twice as often') does not clearly move goal-1 (a revenue goal) (goal-outcome-alignment or misaligned-item)
Flags that outcome-1's statement ('Customers renew') and behaviorChange ('Customers open the app more') tell different stories (statement-behavior-mismatch)
Flags that item-2 and item-4 duplicate the same intent (duplicate-intent)
Nudges name entities by their statement or title, never by raw IDs like 'outcome-2'
